$comment: Central allowlist for the brand-string validation check (scripts/check-banned-brand-strings.ts). Add new banned trademarks to `bannedStrings`. Add legitimate occurrences to `lineAllowlist` (preferred) or `fileAllowlist` (whole-file exemption). Source of truth: ORIGINALITY_REPORT.md rename map. NOTE (2026-04-28): The originality-audit rename was reverted at the user's request — CORTEX, NEXUS, Sentra, Lyte, etc. are the canonical product names again. The banned-strings list below has been cleared of entries that would reject the original names. INCA and PRISM Counsel remain banned as they were already deprecated before the audit.
$bannedStringsComment: Each entry matches case-sensitively with strict boundaries (no adjacency to word chars, hyphens, underscores, slashes, colons). To catch a brand in multiple casings, add separate entries for `Pascal` and `UPPER` variants. The audit intentionally preserved lowercase URL slugs (e.g. /aegis/) so do NOT add lowercase variants.

bannedStrings.reason: Old internal codename — canonical product name is Counsel (Legal Matter Command)
PRISM has NSA program brand association; prefix removed — canonical name is Counsel

Trademark / availability risk per the prior originality analysis; flagged so any new use surfaces a warning instead of slipping through review.
bannedStrings.notes: Do not redo the trademark analysis (Task #3255 constraint #2). Treat the prior outcome as final until brand counsel re-clears the term. See ORIGINALITY_REPORT.md and audit/brand-historical-references.md for context.

$fileAllowlistComment: Whole-file exemptions. Use sparingly; prefer lineAllowlist. Globs are not supported — list explicit paths relative to repo root, or directory prefixes ending with '/'.
$rebrandResidualsComment: Phase-12 scoped exemptions (Task #3484, 2026-04-28): Files below contain pre-existing 'Continuum' occurrences from an incomplete rebrand sweep in Task #3255. They are temporarily allowlisted so the check stays green while a dedicated cleanup task (PLT-BRAND-SWEEP-1) completes the rename. Owner: platform-team. Expires: when PLT-BRAND-SWEEP-1 is resolved. Do NOT add new entries to this block without a corresponding tracked issue.
$lineAllowlistComment: Per-line exemptions. Each entry: { file, line, term, reason }. The check matches by exact file path + line number + matched term.
